title: Non-self adjoint spectral problems
exact_target: Understand and compute non-self-adjoint spectra, especially the semiclassical scattering spectrum of focusing nonlinear Schrödinger equations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000007 (AMR-079-0007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 7.

status_qualification: The source’s programme includes eigenvalue accumulation location and rate for general-data AKNS operators. Its informal assertion about pseudomodes throughout the numerical range is source context, not an added universal theorem for arbitrary operators. The source’s distance wording is corrected to reciprocal distance: for self-adjoint A the resolvent norm is the reciprocal of the distance to its spectrum, at resolvent parameters.
